intelligence.enrichment: A stimulus is a change or contact that can cause a living being to respond; animals and plants both show responses to stimuli. When the stimulus is applied, the response follows in the living being, such as withdrawing from heat or a thorn, or a plant folding leaves after touch or light changes. The learner correctly applies this rule: A stimulus is a change or contact that can cause a living being to respond; animals and plants both show responses to stimuli. Only animals can respond to touch, heat, or pain; plants just stay still.
